findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM)
findings.comment:
No CFM was present at time of inspection.  After talking to the PIC, they have spoken to MJ Kellner about signing up for a class through them.  Ensure at least a couple people are certified for future events so there will be at least one person present.

2-102.12: (A) The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a certified FOOD protection manager who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment:
Quat test strips had been recently purchased, but the facility uses chlorine.  Discussed with PIC. Ensure the proper test strips are obtained.  Test strips were left for tonight’s event.

4-302.14: A test kit or other device that accurately measures the concentration in MG/L of SANITIZING solutions shall be provided.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
REPEAT:  Hand washing sink was not supplied with paper towels.  Discussed with PIC who filled paper towel holder on site.  Ensure paper towels are present at all times.

A plastic cup was present in the hand washing sink.  Inspector discarded and discussed with PIC.  Ensure members are only using hand washing sink for washing hands.

6-301.12: Each HANDWASHING SINK shall be provided with: (A) Individual, disposable towels; (B) A continuous towel system that supplies the user with a clean towel; (C) A heated-air hand drying device; (D) A hand drying device that employs an air-knife system that delivers high velocity, pressurized air at ambient temperatures.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
4-602.13: NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

Some food splatter present on wall behind stove/fryer station in kitchen. Discussed with PIC. Ensure members clean and sanitize all surfaces after using them. Do not allow grease or food debris to accumulate on surfaces, discussed pest and contamination risk.

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present
findings.comment:
6-202.15: (A) Outer openings of FOOD ESTABLISHMENT shall be protected against entry of insects and rodents. 

Back door in kitchen observed to have a small gap, allowing sunlight in. Discussed with PIC. Ensure external openings remain fully sealed to protect against pest and/or weather entry. Will follow up at next routine.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
6-301.12: Each HANDWASHING SINK shall be provided with: (A) Individual, disposable towels; 
Handwashing sink at bar area and handwashing sink in the kitchen both lack supply of paper towels. Discussed with PIC. Ensure handwashing sinks remain supplied with soap and towels at all times. Encourage members to wash hands often while using kitchen and/or cooking for events.
